word_count_rule: Whitespace-separated tokens within prose paragraphs between ## Research brief and ## References. Title, metadata, and reference lists excluded. Inline code terms count as tokens; an unspaced hyphenated term counts once.
paragraph_rule: Nonempty prose blocks separated by blank lines within the research brief. No bullets, headings, or isolated labels counted. Each observed paragraph has at least 64 words.
hash_scope: SHA-256 entries cover all payload files except manifest.json itself. The manifest lists itself but omits a self-hash. The ZIP is outside the payload and is validated by CRC, inventory, and byte agreement rather than a circular in-manifest archive hash.

limitations: The packet is not a runnable checkout.
Assets, datasets, dependencies, generated output, and historical raw research were omitted.
Source inspection and literal reference checks do not establish runtime behavior.
Candidate novelty was checked against available source, intent, and this collection; omitted historical research was not reviewed.
All quantitative thresholds in proposed experiments are future acceptance criteria, not measured results.
Later Codex work owns local reconciliation, validation, commits, and a docs-only review PR.
